evidence_policy: Canonical repository data remains authoritative. Current catalogue/DLC/PQ evidence corroborates identity, mechanics, and acquisition endpoints. No reward probability, first-clear rule, or hidden implementation detail is inferred.

findings.super-soul-153: Current sources disagree on the magnitude of the always-on Ki-restoration reduction (-30% in the canonical record/current Super Soul table versus 25% on a character-specific page).
